title: Quick Tip: BC28: What Is New in Document Reporting
summary: BC28 introduces enhanced document reporting features including an improved Word add-in with a redesigned data picker, a new table builder for layouts, lifecycle status management for user-defined layouts, company-level default document language, tooltips on reports, modernized report selection pages, and 36 new document APIs covering sales, purchasing, inventory, and assembly document types.
key_points: The Word add-in data picker is redesigned: fields insert on double-click, the cursor moves to the next cell in tables, one search covers all data items, a new action shows metadata, and dark mode is supported.
Table Builder, still in preview, adds an Insert Table action that builds the header, repeater, mapped columns and an optional footer from a single dialog.
User-defined layouts can be Draft, Pending Approval, Approved or Retired. Only Approved ones appear on report request pages, and layouts shipped by extensions are not covered yet.
A new Default Language Code on Company Information is used after the customer card language and before the user's UI language.
36 new API endpoints cover sales, purchasing, inventory and assembly documents. The modernized report selection pages come in a later 28.x minor update.

quotes.text: The table builder compresses all of that into a single dialog.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how the new feature significantly reduces the manual work required to build Word document layouts with complex table structures.
